```{r, echo = F}
trajectory <- read_csv("../data/processed/glm_trajectory_type_threatlevel_convicted_ACS_MPI.csv")
sum(trajectory$n_arrests)

trajectory_ca <- trajectory %>%
  filter(method == "CA")

days_pre_period  <- abs(min(trajectory_ca$window)) * 60
days_post_period <- (max(trajectory_ca$window) + 1) * 60

window_level <- trajectory_ca %>%
  filter(window >= -1) %>%
  mutate(
    conv_method = ifelse(convicted == 1, "CA_conv", "CA_nonconv")
  ) %>%
  group_by(region, state, window, conv_method) %>%
  select(-threat_level, method) %>% 
  summarize(
    pop_MPI = first(pop_MPI),
    n_arrests = sum(n_arrests),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

conv_method_state <- window_level %>%
  mutate(window = ifelse(window >= 0, 0, -1)) %>%
  group_by(region, state, window, conv_method) %>%
  summarize(
    pop_MPI = mean(pop_MPI),
    n_arrests = sum(n_arrests),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    nesting(region, state, pop_MPI),
    window = c(-1, 0),
    conv_method = c("CA_conv", "CA_nonconv"),
    fill = list(n_arrests = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(region = ifelse(region == "EUCA", "EUCA", "nonEUCA")) %>% 
  group_by(region, window, state, conv_method) %>% 
  summarize(pop_MPI = sum(pop_MPI),
    n_arrests = sum(n_arrests),
    .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(
    ratio = (n_arrests / pop_MPI) * 1000,
    ratio_annualized = ratio * ifelse(window == 0, 60 / days_post_period, 1),
    post = as.integer(window == 0),
    non_euca = as.integer(region == "nonEUCA"),
    is_nonconv = as.integer(conv_method == "CA_nonconv")
  )

ddd_model <- feols(
  ratio_annualized ~ post:non_euca + post:non_euca:is_nonconv |
    region^conv_method + window^conv_method,
  data = conv_method_state,
  weights = ~ pop_MPI,
  cluster = ~ state
)

summary(ddd_model)

ddd_term <- "post:non_euca:is_nonconv"
est <- coef(ddd_model)[ddd_term]
ci <- confint(ddd_model)[ddd_term, ]

print(unname(c(est, ci[1], ci[2])))
```
